{"notes": "Picture (5:00): Fish outline still complete in shape, but both issues from 2:45 remain. (1) The pale, unconnected cluster on the upper tail just past the crossing (~23-24, 8.5-9.3) is still disconnected, so the chain beyond it (to the upper tail tip) won't topple from the start. (2) The belly line is still doubled around (19-22, 11-13). No hand labels were visible and nobody spoke while I was there, so I can't tell who is working on what.

Sofia: Claimed the crossing-to-upper-tail section and said she was on her last domino, but the pale gap in that section is still open. Called the doubled joint 'fine' without checking. Leadership and collaboration credit stands (clear split, reassured Jack). Execution is still unproven and now slightly worrying. Ask her directly what she placed and why the gap persists.

Omar: Offered to nudge the off-to-side domino before the crossing. I still can't confirm he did it or whether the pale cluster is his. Ask him.

Hana: Took the crossing join and the belly connects through it. Nothing new seen or heard. Ask what she placed.

Jack: Took the inspector role on the doubled joint. The doubling and gap are still there, so ask whether he found them and told anyone. Hold off on judging until he answers.

Next visit: check whether the pale cluster is connected and the doubling resolved. Ask each person what they placed, and who owns the gap."}
